title: 上海浦东选纹绣工作室，可以先核对什么
title_en: Choosing a brow studio in Pudong
intro: 不只比较项目名。真实作品、实际操作者、设计过程和清楚的服务条款，更有助于判断是否适合。
intro_en: Look beyond service names. Real work, the practitioner, the design process and clear service terms provide a more useful basis for a decision.

sections.title: 核对作品与设计
sections.description: 看整脸比例和近照细节，询问原生眉基础与恢复阶段。没有标注的信息，不自行当成术后长期效果。
sections.description_en: Review full-face proportions and close-up detail. Ask about the starting point and healing stage. Do not assume an unlabelled image shows a long-term result.

sections.title: 确认人和条款
sections.description: 问谁设计、谁操作，先设计还是先定项目；同时确认护理、补色与当前价格信息。不要用单一设备名称代替这些问题。
sections.description_en: Ask who designs and who performs the work, and whether you can see a design before choosing a service. Confirm aftercare, touch-ups and current prices. An equipment name does not answer these questions.

sections.title: 描眉画目的到店信息
sections.description: 工作室在上海市浦东新区三林长清路1200弄39号1613室，前滩南侧。地铁6号线灵岩南路站2号口往西步行约300米。周一至周日10:00–20:00，建议提前预约。
sections.description_en: The studio is at Room 1613, No. 39, Lane 1200 Changqing Road, Sanlin, Pudong, south of Qiantan. Walk about 300 metres west from Exit 2 of Lingyan South Road station on Metro Line 6. Open daily 10:00–20:00, by appointment.
